extension.description: Log any expression in one keystroke, then switch every generated log off with one command before you commit. Stop the process holding your dev port, silence the editor's "installation appears to be corrupt" warning, and clear the editor's history and caches in one go.
config.prefix: Prefix included in generated console log messages.
view.ports.name: Port Toolkit
config.ports.refreshInterval: How often the Port Toolkit view rescans, in milliseconds, while the view is visible. Set to 0 to refresh only on demand.
config.ports.killTimeout: How long to wait after SIGTERM before escalating to SIGKILL, in milliseconds.
config.ports.hideSystemProcesses: Hide processes that live in system directories or only listen on ports at or below the system port maximum.
config.ports.systemPortMax: Highest port number treated as a system port. A process is only hidden when every port it listens on is at or below this value.
config.ports.includeUdp: Also list UDP endpoints, not just TCP listeners.
